videoTitle: NORTH OF MOROCCO 🇲🇦 فشمال F' lvan ها علاش مقدرتش نبات
videoDescription: Welcome back to my channel La Mambah Fam 😇 This time we're heading towards the north of Morocco 🇲🇦, which is completely different from the south. I felt like being in two different countries at once 😅. We've decided to head to the north because my friend, Kevin, had to leave back to Germany, and it was easier for him if we were already close to the Moroccan border 🚧. To be honest, my favorite place in the north was Chefchaouen 💙, and you can notice it on the vlog 😅, I think it was the main focus! This city in the middle of the mountains is amazing, filled with good energy! I definitely recommend visiting if you're up north! Something else that you might have to know if you're planning on doing a van trip in Morocco 🇲🇦, I would recommend doing it in the south, because the north is not that appealing for caravans 🚐. videoTitle: You want to learn how to mealprep? 🥦
videoDescription: Here is one of my fav simple and easy meal prep that will set you up for the week 🚀 First of all, prepare all the ingredients, so you have everything ready before starting to cook 👨🏽‍🍳 𝐌𝐀𝐂𝐑𝐎𝐒 𝐏𝐄𝐑 𝐏𝐎𝐑𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍: 𝟒𝟖𝟐 𝐊𝐂𝐀𝐋 / 𝟒𝟔,𝟔𝐠 𝐏𝐑𝐎𝐓 / 𝟓𝟒𝐠 𝐂𝐀𝐑𝐁𝐒 / 𝟏𝟎,𝟑𝐠 𝐅𝐀𝐓 𝐈𝐍𝐆𝐑𝐄𝐃𝐈𝐄𝐍𝐓𝐒 𝐅𝐎𝐑 𝟓 𝐏𝐎𝐑𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍𝐒 : - 1 big broccoli 🥦 - 1 green pepper 🫑 - 2 red peppers - 1kg of chicken breast🍗 (you can put less if you want less protein) - 200g basmati rice 🍚 Start by cutting all the ingredients in small pieces, and put aside. In a small pot, cook the rice for 10 min approx, and in the meantime, in a large pot, add 1 table spoon olive oil 🫒, let it warm for a bit and add all the peppers and the chicken together. I seasoned my chicken with salt and pepper 🧂. While the rice and the chicken is cooking, add some soya sauce 🥢 (at your convenience) and stir the pot to make the chicken absorb the sauce 🤤. Add the broccoli inside the pot and let it cook for a few minutes. Once the rice is done, add it to the pot to mix everything together. Add some teriyaki sauce (just some 😏), mix all together and let it cool down. When everything is ready, take your boxes, fill them in 5 portions and here you gooooo !! Ready for your next 5 meals 🚀
